description: Chronicler verified: git diff dacf642..wf/{init,crash,receive,notes} -- Leanactors.lean shows no import changes, so the builder's warned 'trivial merge conflict' does not materialise in this workflow. wf/receive edits SupervisorProof.lean but only rewrites Inv.frame call sites inside Inv.step (adding stateOf_deliver rewrites); the Inv.frame signature (hnext, hsup, halive, hlinks, hsigs, hcount) is unchanged, so SysPropsDemo.lean should build after merge. wf/sysprops touches no file under elixir/ or Leanactors/Gen/, so it is orthogonal to the to_lean.exs render_clauses/clauses/sends/plain_body conflicts between wf/crash, wf/init and wf/receive. Merge order does not matter for this piece; import lines in Leanactors.lean go after Leanactors.Sys and at the end of the file.
title: Merge surface for wf/sysprops: only this branch edits Leanactors.lean imports (wf/init, wf/crash, wf/receive, wf/notes add none), so no sibling conflict there; SysPropsDemo.lean depends on SupervisorProof's Inv.frame/Inv.next_pos/sup_alive/child_ok/beh/sig, whose signatures wf/receive leaves unchanged; SysProps.lean itself imports only Leanactors.Sys
